name: Tsurumi Yoshiharu
source:
A resident of the same apartment building as Shuichi and Nanami.

His wife, Sanae, is close friends with Nanami, and as a result, the Tsurumi and Honda families also maintain a close, family-like relationship.

He works as the hired manager of a nearby supermarket. However, his wife considers him a hopeless husband.

He spends his days secretly comparing Nanami with Sanae, who is strong-willed and not particularly attractive, and sighing over the differences between them.

Even at the supermarket where he works, the veteran part-time female employees have secretly branded him a "useless manager."

He feels increasingly stressed and out of place, with nowhere he truly belongs.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
